description: This file defines the ColumnStackedPlotAreaRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering stacked column plot areas in charts within the PDFsharp library. It calculates positions and sizes of stacked columns and determines that data is always inside the plot area.

classes.name: ColumnStackedPlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: A renderer for stacked column plot areas, drawing columns stacked on top of each other.

methods.name: CalcColumns
methods.description: Calculates the position, width, and height of each stacked column in the plot area.

methods.name: IsDataInside
methods.description: Indicates that stacked columns are always considered inside the plot area.
